operative_boundary: Only .ai-workflow/ is installed/passed as the workflow runtime; other folders are development/reference storage for the workflow project itself.
canonical_read_order: ROADMAP.md (only when future work is needed)

architecture.hierarchy: Goal -> Plan -> Phase -> DIC -> EPS -> Prompt/Run -> Action
architecture.dic: exactly one durable multi-view DIC per Phase
architecture.initial_eps_owner: Main authors the initial EPS/prompt graph from the approved DIC/PLAN.md.
architecture.orchestrator_eps_role: Orchestrator validates/model-tunes and executes the initial EPS; it may issue bounded superseding repair EPS revisions under an unchanged DIC.
architecture.phase_storage: Project-local Phase materials live at repository-root phases/<phase_id>/, not inside .ai-workflow/.
architecture.phase_import: aw phase import <zip> safely imports a Main-produced Phase package, validates the DIC/EPS package, scaffolds Phase evidence/report folders, and registers state.

design_objective: Reduce human supervisory attention required per unit of verified research progress while preserving scientific quality, evidence integrity, and human authority.
current_status: v5.6.39 initial-EPS ownership, root Phase filesystem, safe Phase ZIP import, long-form documentation, Education plan, and submission surfaces validated.

default_phase_tree.EPS/: Main-authored initial EPS plus bounded repair EPS attempts
results/: KEY_RESULTS.json when key results are naturally structured
KEY_RESULTS.csv when a tabular representation is natural
